target.statement: For smooth projective complex X and codimension p, image(CH^p(X)_Q -> H^(2p)(X,Q)) equals H^(2p)(X,Q) intersect H^(p,p)(X).
target.claimCeiling: No current project artifact proves the Hodge conjecture.

claims.subject: K3 Hodge diamond
claims.statement: K3 is a real-four-dimensional complex surface with Hodge diamond middle row (1,20,1) and Betti numbers (1,0,22,0,1).
claims.notClaimed: The Hodge diamond alone determines algebraic-cycle structure.

claims.subject: Kummer construction
claims.statement: An abelian surface quotient by inversion and resolution supplies a K3 calibration with sixteen exceptional curves and nontrivial integral gluing issues.
claims.notClaimed: Rational dimension bookkeeping is the full integral K3 lattice.

claims.subject: Fermat quartic lines
claims.statement: The current calibration constructs 48 lines and records a rank-20 rational intersection span.
claims.notClaimed: Every quartic K3 has Picard rank 20 or 48 independent divisor classes.

claims.subject: Cubic fourfold calibration
claims.statement: Smooth cubic fourfolds are retained as codimension-two/period/Hodge-locus calibration objects rather than open ordinary H^4 Hodge instances.
claims.notClaimed: The general Hodge conjecture follows from the cubic-fourfold case.

claims.subject: 24-cell / quaternion / D4 / E6
claims.statement: These structures provide finite symmetry, root-system, and representation-theoretic calibration material usable for partitioning searches when an explicit geometric action is certified.
claims.notClaimed: Numerical or diagrammatic resemblance identifies K3 cohomology or proves algebraicity.

claims.subject: P-vs-NP range avoidance transfer
claims.statement: Search for rational Hodge classes outside the span of currently known algebraic-cycle classes to identify an incomplete generator family and target new cycle constructions.
claims.notClaimed: A class outside the known span is non-algebraic.

claims.subject: P-vs-NP sharing discipline
claims.statement: Independent mathematical structure must be measured after relations and reuse are accounted for, not by raw construction count.
claims.notClaimed: Circuit DAG complexity and Chow-group relations are the same object.

claims.subject: Symmetry promise discipline
claims.statement: A symmetry action becomes computationally useful only after the action, quotient, target sector, and required promise are certified.
claims.notClaimed: Large automorphism groups automatically reduce cycle search.

claims.subject: 4D observer/projection transfer
claims.statement: A distinction lost under a projection or coordinate elimination can remain genuine in the source object, so source coordinates and maps must be retained during geometric reductions.
claims.notClaimed: Synthetic 4D observer experiments establish a physical dimension or Hodge theorem.

claims.subject: Representation-sector deficit
claims.statement: For a certified group action, D_rho = dim(H_rho) - dim(A_rho) is a targeted search statistic for missing known algebraic-cycle sectors.
claims.notClaimed: Positive D_rho proves the corresponding Hodge classes are non-algebraic.

claims.subject: Conscience64 cooperation
claims.statement: Conscience64 may navigate, reflow, recover, and preserve typed relations and claim ceilings for the Hodge program.
claims.notClaimed: Conscience64 agreement supplies independent mathematical evidence.

bridges.target: known-cycle span versus rational Hodge target
bridges.counterprobe: Verify that an outside-known-span class is not mislabeled outside the full algebraic image.
Construct two source objects collapsing under the selected projection and test whether the Hodge-relevant invariant differs.
Record exactly what each map forgets and reject inverse claims without an inverse theorem.
